questions.question: Does this work?
questions.answer: 'The Testing Effect' demonstrates that learning through self-testing is significantly more effective than passive reading. StudyPhii was designed to help students leverage this principle by offering AI-generated practice questions tailored to the topics they wish to learn.

questions.question: Is there a free trial?
questions.answer: Unfortunately, there is no free trial available. Running AI services is quite expensive, but we've worked hard to keep our pricing affordable. For instance, while ChatGPT charges $20 per month, StudyPhii is available for under $4 per month, and it’s even cheaper with a lifetime plan.

questions.question: How do I get started?
questions.answer: 1. Login with your Google Account. 2. Pick a plan. 3. Start learning.
